### A fourth voice: the fairness check

I read audit summaries, public notices, and old case records. I have seen one company stop an internal hiring tool after learning that it used past résumés and rated résumés linked to women lower. I also see rules moving at different speeds. New York City requires a recent independent bias check for tools covered by its law. The EU treats hiring AI as high risk. I see that Japan does not yet have an equivalent audit law. I am asking whether anyone can inspect the process when a person is harmed.
